text: Timing, mostly. If I leave before 15:00, the guards send me right back.

And yes, my mother is still one of those reasons.

One of the monster books was mostly pictures, but it still counts.
Don't talk to me about this city. I have opinions and none of them are polite.

Half-day restrictions wreck full-day schedules. That's sailor math.

Some say possession. Some say madness. Some even say revenge.

Shops still open, ale still pours, but nobody means their laughter. Every street sounds like people talking around a wound.
Storms break masts and move on. This kind of grief sits in the timber and creaks for years.
